تجتذبين (form VIII)
# تَجْتَذِبِينَ (tajtaḏibīna) /tad͡ʒ.ta.ði.biː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِجْتَذَبَ (ijtaḏaba)
# تُجْتَذَبِينَ (tujtaḏabīna) /tud͡ʒ.ta.ða.biː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِجْتَذَبَ (ijtaḏaba)
